name: Reorder
purpose: Drag-and-drop affordances for reordering items in a list: a grab handle (default/hover) and a drop-zone highlight that shows where the dragged item will land. Used by reorderable lists (e.g. List items, Quick actions).

props.name: state
props.$note: Drag handle; hover web only. Cursor shows grab → grabbed during drag.

variants.name: drag-handle
variants.use: Grab handle (icon/default); hover fills the target with tertiary/background/hover. Cursor changes grab→grabbed while dragging.

variants.name: drop-zone-highlight
variants.use: Green insertion line/zone (rag/success) marking where the item will drop.

accessibility.keyboardAlt: Drag-to-reorder MUST have a keyboard/AT-accessible alternative (e.g. move up/down controls) and announce the new position (4.1.2/2.1.1)
accessibility.handleName: The drag handle needs an accessible name (e.g. 'Reorder <item>')
accessibility.dropZone: The green drop indicator must not be the only cue — announce target position to AT; green alone should not carry meaning (1.4.1)

antiPatterns: Drag-only reordering with no keyboard alternative
Conveying the drop target by the green highlight colour alone
Unlabelled drag handle (icon with no accessible name)

tokenValidation.against: token store re-based on Figma native variable export

depricateUsage.note: None. Handle = icon/default + tertiary/background/hover; drop-zone = rag/success.
